### 🟢 Approval recommended There are no active review issues for the logger routing and writer-guard lifetime changes. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #205 by correcting the logger output switches and keeping the file writer guard alive throughout the application run. **Changes:** - Gates stdout with `logger.console` and file output with `logger.directory`. - Extracts subscriber construction into a testable helper and retains the writer guard in `main`. - Adds four unit tests covering every console/file switch combination. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `src/​main.rs` | Corrects logger routing and guard lifetime, extracts subscriber setup, and adds switch-combination tests. |
Review effort: Balanced
